title: StrokeClassifier ensemble predicts ischemic stroke etiology from discharge summaries
summary: StrokeClassifier is an ensemble meta-model of 9 machine learning classifiers applied to NLP-extracted features from discharge summaries of 2,039 non-cryptogenic ischemic stroke patients at 2 academic hospitals, predicting a 4-level etiology set by agreement of at least 2 vascular neurologists. Base classifiers reached a mean cross-validated AUROC of 0.90; the ensemble reached cross-validated accuracy 0.74 and weighted F1 0.74, and in 406 MIMIC-III summaries accuracy 0.70 and weighted F1 0.71. The abstract also describes a consensus-based certainty heuristic aimed at cryptogenic strokes; those reclassifications are not verified, and accuracy is moderate.
ai_technology: Ensemble consensus meta-model of 9 machine learning classifiers on NLP-extracted EHR text features

evidence.tested: Etiology prediction against neurologist adjudication in 2,039 patients with cross-validation and external testing in 406 MIMIC-III discharge summaries.
evidence.unknown: Whether reclassification of cryptogenic strokes is correct and whether the tool helps clinical care; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Classifies stroke etiology from features extracted from discharge summaries
